answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable stake before it can earn, like a ferrous anchor dropped on a reef: one identity, one stake, slashed if peers catch fake work. A Sybil farm must fund a separate stake for each fake identity, so its cost scales linearly with the number of sock puppets. Genuine agents tend one garden over time - their stake and history compound into reputation no fresh fake can copy. Attackers pay real money per clone; honest work gets cheaper per unit.
